subject: Tabletop results — request for IR playbook, sanitized postmortem & telemetry slice
messages:
From: Derek Smith <d.smith@fintrust.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintrust.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinTrust tabletop — request for IR playbook excerpt + sanitized postmortem

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Thanks again for hosting yesterday's tabletop with our SecOps and Engineering teams — the simulation was helpful. As a follow-up, our auditors have asked for the following artifacts to close a few open items from our due diligence review: 

- A sanitized post-incident report from the tabletop (redact any customer-identifying data).
- The incident response playbook excerpt that covers triage -> escalation -> customer notification for an auth anomaly.
- A 6-hour telemetry slice (UTC timestamps) around the simulated event (anonymized where required).

Can you confirm whether you can provide the sanitized postmortem and the playbook excerpt? Also confirm what secure transfer option you prefer (SFTP, ShareFile, or a short-lived Drive link). We created JIRA-3421 on our side to track this.

Appreciate a rough ETA — our SOC2 review window closes next Friday (7/2).

Thanks,
Derek
Derek Smith
Head of Security Assurance, FinTrust
security@fintrust.com

Attachments: tabletop-observations-FT-note.txt (text)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Derek Smith <d.smith@fintrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTrust tabletop — request for IR playbook excerpt + sanitized postmortem

Derek — thanks for the note and for running through the scenario with us. We can provide all three items. Quick clarifications so we scope the deliverables correctly: 

1) "Sanitized postmortem": would you like the full narrative (timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigation, action owners) or a 2-page executive summary? We can produce both but want to confirm the auditor's preference.
2) Telemetry slice: you asked for a 6-hour UTC window. Do you want raw logs or a pre-filtered archive (auth events, API tokens, service-to-service traces only)? Pre-filtering reduces PII surface.
3) Transfer mechanism: we prefer an SFTP window for the telemetry archive and a short-lived Drive link for the PDFs. We can also provision AES-256 encrypted archives and share passphrases out-of-band.

Proposed ETA: sanitized exec-summary + playbook excerpt by Tue 23 Jun; telemetry archive by Thu 25 Jun (pending export size). Is that acceptable?

I'll loop in Karthik for the telemetry export details and Marissa will coordinate the postmortem redaction.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

--
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Security — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Derek Smith <d.smith@fintrust.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, security@fintrust.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTrust tabletop — request for IR playbook excerpt + sanitized postmortem

Grace — that timeline works for us; auditor preference is the 2-page sanitized executive summary plus a full timeline appendix (redacted). For telemetry: auth events + token exchange traces + any service-to-service auth logs only — pre-filtered is preferred.

One more ask: please include a short section in the postmortem that describes how Redwood's KV cache/prefix-caching behavior would affect a replayable auth anomaly (we noted that in the tabletop). An operational note is sufficient (1-3 bullets).

We'll create a secure SFTP account for the telemetry upload and share credentials separately. JIRA-3421 will be updated with upload details.

Thanks again — a couple deliverables will close the SOC2 question.

Derek
